plugin.note: Salve amulet works because Ankou are undead, but it does not stack with Slayer helmet or Black mask. Melee is fast in single combat, while Catacombs/Wilderness multicombat can use Burst, Barrage, or Venator bow. Cannon works in every listed location except Catacombs; Wilderness locations require low risk and a one-click teleport.

requirements: 40 combat is required to receive Ankou assignments.
No Slayer level or quest requirement.
Ankou very much extends assignments to 91-150 Ankou.
Wilderness Slayer Cave and The Forgotten Cemetery require accepting Wilderness player-killing risk.
mechanics: Ankou use a relatively inaccurate melee attack with a max hit from 8 to 10.
Protect from Melee negates all Ankou damage.
Ankou are undead, so Salve amulet variants can boost accuracy and damage.
Salve amulet bonuses do not stack with Slayer helmet or Black mask bonuses; only the best applicable multiplier should matter.
Ankou are Spectral creatures, so Ectoplasmator gives Prayer experience on kills.
Ankou are the only spectral monster that also drops bones, so Bonecrusher or Bonecrusher necklace adds Prayer experience.
In the Catacombs of Kourend, Bonecrusher restores one Prayer point per Ankou kill.
Area-of-effect Salve necklace bonuses apply only to the primary target, not to secondary monsters hit by the spell.
Dark Ankou are Skotizo summons and are normally ignored; damaged Dark Ankous that die when Skotizo dies do not count for task progress.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Use Protect from Melee and choose between quick single-combat melee, cannon-assisted locations, or fast multicombat magic/ranged methods depending on cost and risk.
recommendedFor: choosing safe locations versus Wilderness locations
requiredOrKeyItems: Herb/rune pickup space for Death runes and Blood runes
steps: Pick a location based on assignment source, cannon preference, and Wilderness tolerance.
Use Protect from Melee if taking damage.
Choose between Slayer helmet or Salve amulet using current stats and gear; their bonuses do not stack.
Bring Ectoplasmator for extra Prayer experience.
Bring Bonecrusher or Bonecrusher necklace if Prayer experience or Catacombs Prayer restoration is useful.
Expect Death runes and Blood runes over a typical task.
In Catacombs, also expect Ancient shard and Dark totem piece drops.
risks: Wilderness Slayer Cave and Forgotten Cemetery are player-killing hotspots.
Area-of-effect methods can consume even extended tasks quickly.
notes: Salve amulet bonuses apply because Ankou are undead.
Slayer helmet and Black mask do not stack with Salve amulet bonuses.

methods.label: Single-combat melee
methods.summary: Melee is a fast, simple option for unextended Ankou tasks in single-combat locations.
steps: Use single-target melee in Stronghold of Security, Stronghold Slayer Cave, Deepfin Mine, or other single-combat assignments.
Protect from Melee removes incoming damage when needed.
Use Salve amulet if it is better than the Slayer helmet or Black mask for the player's current gear.
Use Ectoplasmator and Bonecrusher for passive Prayer experience.
Pick up Death runes and Blood runes if desired.
fallbacks: If melee gear is poor, use magic or ranged in Catacombs or Wilderness multicombat areas.
risks: Single-combat is slower than multicombat AoE but uses fewer supplies.

methods.label: Multicombat magic
methods.summary: Use Burst or Barrage spells in Catacombs of Kourend or Wilderness Slayer Cave for a very fast task.
recommendedFor: players prioritizing speed over task length
steps: Use Catacombs of Kourend or Wilderness Slayer Cave because both are multicombat Ankou locations.
Group Ankou where practical and cast Burst or Barrage spells.
Expect the task to finish quickly, even when extended.
Remember Salve necklace effects do not apply to secondary monsters hit by area-of-effect spells.
In Catacombs, use Bonecrusher for Prayer restoration from buried bones.
risks: Wilderness Slayer Cave adds player-killing risk.
Area-of-effect spells consume assignments quickly and cost runes.

methods.label: Multicombat ranged
methods.summary: Venator bow is viable in multicombat Ankou areas and can clear even extended assignments quickly.
steps: Use Venator bow in Catacombs or Wilderness Slayer Cave to bounce between nearby Ankou.
Keep Protect from Melee active if taking damage.
Use Bonecrusher in Catacombs for Prayer restoration.
Expect rapid task completion.
risks: Wilderness Slayer Cave adds player-killing risk.
The task can end very quickly when using Venator bow in multicombat.

methods.label: Cannon
methods.summary: Cannon can speed up Ankou tasks in every listed location except the Catacombs of Kourend.
steps: Use a cannon when the location allows it and the higher cost is acceptable.
Do not use cannon in the Catacombs of Kourend because it is not allowed there.
Stronghold Slayer Cave and Wilderness Slayer Cave are explicitly useful cannon locations from the variant notes.
risks: Higher cost than melee-only task completion.
Wilderness cannoning increases exposure to player killers.

methods.label: Wilderness
methods.summary: Keep risk low in Wilderness Slayer Cave or The Forgotten Cemetery, bring a one-click teleport, and watch Wilderness level restrictions.
prayers: Protect Item when risking an extra item
steps: Minimise risk before entering the Wilderness.
Carry a one-click teleport usable in the 20-30 Wilderness range, such as a Royal seed pod.
Remember Wilderness Slayer Cave Ankou straddle level 20 Wilderness.
Remember Forgotten Cemetery Ankou straddle level 30 Wilderness.
Leave quickly if player killers appear.
risks: Teleport restrictions become more dangerous around level 30 Wilderness.

styleOptions.label: Melee
styleOptions.summary: Fast, low-cost default for Ankou tasks, especially in single-combat areas.

styleOptions.label: Magic
styleOptions.summary: Burst or Barrage Ankou in Catacombs or Wilderness Slayer Cave for a fast assignment.

styleOptions.label: Ranged
styleOptions.summary: Venator bow is the relevant ranged method in multicombat Ankou areas.
